verdict.rationale: Plausible documents two public HTTP APIs: an Events API for recording pageviews and custom events, and a Stats API (/api/v2/query, JSON POST bodies) with team-scoped API keys for querying historical and real-time stats. Together they let a programmatic or agent consumer read and write analytics data. However, the Stats API is explicitly read-only, nothing documents API control of configuration (sites, goals, funnels), and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: management/configuration API endpoints, an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
